thread:
sana: quick heads-up — seeing tokenization divergence on the Mistral->Qwen conversion during int4 bring-up. small eval set (cv-resumes) has a spike in embedding distance for 'name normalization' examples.

devon: can you paste an example?

sana: yeah. original text: 'Resume — Anaïs Gómez'
sana: converted model produced tokens that don't line up. suspect homoglyph / confusable unicode characters, maybe NFKC normalization mismatch during conversion pipeline.

marta: any token ids?

sana: repro snippet: 

```
# quick tokenizer debug
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok_src = Tokenizer.from_file('mistral/tokenizer.json')
tok_dst = Tokenizer.from_file('qwen/tokenizer.json')
text = 'Resume — Anaïs Gómez'
print(tok_src.encode(text).ids)
print(tok_dst.encode(text).ids)
```

sana: src ids: [154, 23, 4092, 7, 88]  // made-up example showing shorter mapping
sana: dst ids: [154, 9999, 4092, 7, 88] // 9999 is a bogus split/token for the em-dash + non-ascii sequence in qwen tokenization

alex: nice. do you see any differences after applying NFKC?

sana: if I run text = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', text) it fixes it locally. but the conversion tool doesn't normalize by default. conversion pipeline: model weights + vocab remap + tokenizer copy. suspect a tokenizer build step used different normalizer flags.

devon: could also be confusable char: the dash might be U+2014 vs U+002D or the a with diaeresis vs surrogate composed vs decomposed. Those often survive naive copies.

marta: impact on metrics?
sana: on our int4 Mistral->Qwen run: recall on name extraction dropped ~7 points for that eval slice, embedding cosine down 0.12 median for affected examples. not catastrophic but reproducible.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: conversion-job-342 failed token-compatibility-step -> created ticket INF-1289

alex: steps to triage?

sana: plan: 1) run normalization sweep on tokenizer artifacts (NFC/NFKC/NFD) and compare token id maps 2) add a small fuzz test with confusable characters to onboarding smoke 3) re-run quantized int4 eval on the failing slice 4) if fixed, add normalizer flag to conversion tool and patch docs.

devon: I can take 1 + 2. will add test cases for em-dash, U+2013, U+002D, composed/decomposed accents, cyrillic 'а' vs latin 'a' confusable examples.

marta: I'll rerun the int4 eval once you have the fixed tokenizer artifacts. timeline?

devon: aiming EOD PST for the tests, maybe tomorrow morning for the re-eval.

alex: also check kv-cache index mapping — token id shifts can cause kvcache misalignment and subtle generation drift in long context.

sana: good call. I saw one example where kvcache lookup produced shifted attention patterns when token ids differ by an insert.

marta: tagging @legal and @docs? we probably need a short note in the onboarding checklist about unicode normalizers for tokenizers so we don't reintroduce this.

alex: agree. I'll add a short PR template: "tokenizer.normalizer set?" checkbox.

sana: thanks all. devon assign me INF-1289 when you have the patch. adding repro data and a minimal failing eval set to the ticket. :thumbsup:

devon: will do. dropping the test PR link here once ready.
